steps.name: Preconditions
steps.objective: The deployment holds live operational data before retirement begins

steps.name: Capability revocation
steps.objective: Every agent capability is revoked before any data is deleted

steps.name: Operational data deletion
steps.objective: Every operational record is deleted and none remains readable

steps.name: Audit retention and integrity
steps.objective: The tamper-evident audit chain survives deletion and still verifies

steps.name: No service after retirement
steps.objective: The retired deployment refuses agent runs, serves no corpus, and has no proposals

summary.scope: Synthetic local data only. Operational records are deleted and the tamper-evident audit chain is retained as the record that retirement occurred. This exercises no provider deletion, no backup expiry, no legal hold, and no downstream termination, and no retention schedule is approved (BLK-001, REQ-DAT-007).
